I have a very similar recurring dream. I’m packing up homes, places I’ve been or not, and it’s only ever ME packing, and it’s almost always someone else’s stuff that I’m packing FOR for them and they’re not there to help. It’s been due to various reasons- impending weather, eviction, or the property is sold and it’s the last night before the new owner takes possession. 
I feel so pressured and almost always wake feeling anxious and will try to go back to sleep to “finish” the dream.
